subject: maths
question: The expenses of painting the inner curved surface of a cylindrical vessel 20 m deep is ₹4,400. If the painting rate is ₹40 per m², find the total surface area (in m²) of the vessel correct to two places of decimals. (Used pi = frac{22}7)
solution:
**Given:**

The expenses of painting the inner curved surface = ₹4,400

The painting rate = ₹40 per m²

Depth of the vessel (height, h) = 20 m

pi = dfrac{22}{7}

**Formula used:**

Curved surface area (CSA) of cylinder = 2pi rh

Total surface area (TSA) of cylinder = CSA + 2pi r²

**Calculation:**

Cost of painting curved surface = Painting rate × CSA

⇒ ₹4,400 = ₹40 × CSA

⇒ CSA = ₹4,400 ÷ ₹40

⇒ CS
